[[File:Explorer's ring 4 detail.png|left|150px]]
The '''Explorer's ring 4''' is a reward from completing the [[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary Elite|elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]]. It is received from [[Hatius Cosaintus]] in [[Lumbridge]], and can be retrieved from him for free if lost. Multiple rings can be obtained for free.

The Check option will send a chatbox message with the amount of energy restores, teleports, and alchemy casts remaining for that day.

==Benefits==
[[File:Cabbage teleport.gif|thumb|250px|right|A player teleporting with the [[Explorer's ring]].]]
*Cast [[Low Level Alchemy]] (requires [[Magic]] level 21) or [[High Level Alchemy]] (requires [[Magic]] level 55) without using any runes 30 times per day (however, does not grant any Magic XP for casting)
**Holding the ring while casting this spell from the [[Standard spellbook|spellbook]] will cause [[Fire rune|fire]] and [[Nature rune|nature runes]] to be consumed before charges.
**You can use items on the ring to alchemise them. By default this will trigger a warning which can be toggled in the settings.
*Unlimited teleports to the cabbage patch near [[Falador farm]]
*100% [[Energy|run energy]] replenishment, 3 times per day
**When this is used, a message appears in the player's [[Chat Interface]] displaying the remaining charges.

Daily charges for run energy restoration and free alchemy spells will only replenish after logging out and back in. 

[[Lumbridge & Draynor Diary#Rewards_4|A number of other benefits]] are always active upon claiming rewards from the elite tier of the Lumbridge and Draynor diary.

==Trivia==
* The ring is also called in-game as the "elite explorer ring"{{sic}}, when a player selects the Alchemy option on an [[Explorer's ring 3]] and attempts to select the yet to be unlocked [[High Alchemy]] spell: {{mes|You need the elite explorer ring to do that.}}
* Attempting to use the ring's own [[Alchemy]] spell on it will fail, instead saying {{mes|It feels wrong to use the ring's power on this item.}}
** Casting the spell normally with runes will still work, although it will yield no coins.
